evidence.title: The Missing Dispatch Pouch
evidence.description: The canvas pouch is empty, but its numbered brass tag matches the diplomatic packet on the sorting list.

evidence.title: A Seal Cut and Remade
evidence.description: The red wax is unbroken at a glance, yet a thin blade mark runs beneath the crown. The pouch was opened and resealed.

evidence.title: The Duplicate Punch Mark
evidence.description: A crescent nick in the ticket's edge matches a flaw in the spare brass punch kept with the mail clerks' tools.

evidence.title: Ada Signed for the Packet
evidence.description: Ada's initials acknowledge the diplomatic packet at 23:35. No other clerk was assigned to its sealed pouch.

evidence.title: The Seal Ledger's Discrepancy
evidence.description: Arthur recorded the pouch intact at 23:40, then noted that its crown sat crooked at 00:05.

evidence.title: Ada Took the Van Key
evidence.description: The register shows Ada signed the guard's spare key out at 23:46 and returned it at 23:58.

evidence.title: Seven Minutes at Redbridge
evidence.description: A signal fault held the express between 23:48 and 23:55. The postal carriage remained accessible during the stop.

evidence.title: A Debt to a Foreign Agent
evidence.description: A private letter promises Ada payment if the dispatch reaches an unnamed buyer before dawn. The handwriting is unmistakably hers.

evidence.title: Finn's Punch Has a Square Tooth
evidence.description: Finn's punch leaves square holes. The crescent mark on the dispatch ticket could not have come from his tool.

evidence.title: The Platform Clock Sheet
evidence.description: A porter signed the station sheet at 23:50, placing Finn on the platform while the train stood at Redbridge.

evidence.title: The Scratched Luggage Trunk
evidence.description: Fresh brass filings ring the lock. Inside lies the diplomatic pouch wrapped beneath an old railway blanket.

evidence.title: Wax on the Guard's Gloves
evidence.description: Red wax and a smear of sealing oil stain the fingers of the gloves left beside Arthur's ledger.

evidence.title: Ada's Account of the Stop
evidence.description: Ada says she stayed in the postal carriage sorting parcels through the entire Redbridge stop.
evidence.note: This is Ada's claim, not independent proof.

evidence.title: Arthur Was in the Guard's Van
evidence.description: Arthur says he checked the seal ledger at 23:50. The entry is in his hand, though the door could be opened with a spare key.
evidence.note: A statement supported by a time entry.

evidence.title: Finn's Story of the Stop
evidence.description: Finn says he never boarded the train after departure. The platform clock sheet supports his account at 23:50.
evidence.note: Testimony supported by the station record.
